information:
This is a series competition with [Parsippany Mini AM 2024](https://worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ParsippanyMiniAM2024). You may only register for and compete in one of the two competitions. If you have already registered (with payment) for Parsippany Mini AM 2024, your registration for this competition will be rejected.
